description: Unit tests for POSIX time functions, including gettimeofday, CurrentPosixTime, CurrentMonotonicTime, and gmtime_r, verifying time accuracy, resolution, monotonicity, and correctness of gmtime_r conversion.

methods.name: TimeMatchesGettimeofday
methods.description: Verifies that time() and gettimeofday() return consistent seconds since Unix epoch.

methods.name: TimeIsKindOfSane
methods.description: Checks that CurrentPosixTime() returns a value within a reasonable range (after 2024 and before 2044).

methods.name: HasDecentResolution
methods.description: Ensures CurrentPosixTime() updates within a second, indicating sufficient resolution.

methods.name: MonotonicIsMonotonic
methods.description: Verifies that CurrentMonotonicTime() is strictly increasing and within expected bounds.

methods.name: GmtimeR
methods.description: Tests gmtime_r() converts a fixed timestamp to correct UTC components.
